title: How To Do Overhead Tricep Extensions
hook: Most guys train their biceps and forget about their triceps, but your triceps are the bigger muscle in your arm.
body: This is the overhead tricep extension. First, hold one dumbbell in both hands. Lower it behind your head with your elbows pointing up, then press it back up. Make sure you lower it slowly. If you have to swing your body to move the weight, it's too heavy. Do these on a timer. Go for 30 seconds on, then 30 seconds off.
close: So try these overhead tricep extensions today. Subscribe to my channel and go to SixPackAbs.com for all the newest videos.
pinned_comment: Do you train your triceps as much as your biceps?
youtube_description:
Here's how to do overhead tricep extensions at home with one dumbbell. Hold it in both hands, lower it slowly behind your head with your elbows pointing up, then press it back up. If you have to swing your body, the weight is too heavy.

Go for 30 seconds on, then 30 seconds off. A lot of guys only care about their biceps, but remember to train your triceps too.
